title: 20 January 1964: Live: Olympia Theatre, Paris
content:
The Beatles performed two sets at the Olympia Theatre on this day, continuing their residency which began on 16 January 1964 and ended on 4 February.

During the residency The Beatles’ setlist contained eight songs: ‘From Me To You’, ‘Roll Over Beethoven’, ‘She Loves You’, ‘This Boy’, ‘Boys’, ‘I Want To Hold Your Hand’, ‘Twist And Shout’ and ‘Long Tall Sally’.

This was the fifth date of the residency. The following day The Beatles had a day off, one of just two during their stay in Paris.

Also on this day, a brief interview with the group was broadcast by the Parisian radio station Europe-1, which the previous day had transmitted their matinée show at the Olympia. The interview was during the Robert Marcy show from 12-12.30pm.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024

  • 1982: Paul McCartney appears on the BBC’s Desert Island Discs
  • 1978: Mixing: Morse Moose And The Grey Goose by Wings
  • 1976: Recording: Silly Love Songs by Wings
  • 1975: Recording: Lunch Box/Odd Sox by Wings
  • 1973: Recording, mixing: I Would Only Smile, Seaside Woman, Mystery Train, That’s Alright Mama, Blackpool, Freight Train, Peggy Sue, African Yeah Yeah, Poor Boy, Little Queenie, Oobu Joobu by Wings
  • 1972: Television: John Lennon and Yoko Ono on The Mike Douglas Show
  • 1972: Henry McCullough joins Wings
  • 1971: Travel: John Lennon – Tokyo to London
  • 1971: John Lennon meets Yoko Ono’s parents
  • 1971: Recording: Little Woman Love by Wings
  • 1969: The Beatles meet at Apple’s basement studio
  • 1967: Recording: A Day In The Life
  • 1965: Ringo Starr proposes to Maureen Cox
  • 1964: US album release: Meet The Beatles!
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Lathom Hall, Liverpool
  • 1961: Stuart Sutcliffe leaves Hamburg
